title: StatelessServer application checker terminates when an application is cancelled
author: HassanRady
body_preview: `StatelessServer.application_checker()` terminates permanently when a managed application task is cancelled.  For a cancelled task, `Task.exception()` raises `asyncio.CancelledError`. The checker does not handle this, so it exits before removing the application or inspecting any remaining applications.  Exceptions raised by an overridden `application_exception()` hook have the same effect.  On the...
